تصارعت (form VI)
# تَصَارَعْتُ (taṣāraʕtu) /ta.sˤaː.raʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَصَارَعَ (taṣāraʕa)
# تَصَارَعْتَ (taṣāraʕta) /ta.sˤaː.raʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَصَارَعَ (taṣāraʕa)
# تَصَارَعْتِ (taṣāraʕti) /ta.sˤaː.raʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَصَارَعَ (taṣāraʕa)
# تَصَارَعَتْ (taṣāraʕat) /ta.sˤaː.ra.ʕat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
